Demo JavaScript

JavaScript
function toggleTreeRow(toggle) {
  var row = toggle.closest('tr');
  var level = parseInt(row.dataset.level);
  var expanded = toggle.textContent === '▼';
  toggle.textContent = expanded ? '▶' : '▼';
  var next = row.nextElementSibling;
  while (next && parseInt(next.dataset.level) > level) {
    if (expanded) { next.style.display = 'none'; }
    else { next.style.display = ''; }
    next = next.nextElementSibling;
  }
}

function toggleTreeChildren(parentCb) {
  var row = parentCb.closest('tr');
  var level = parseInt(row.dataset.level);
  var next = row.nextElementSibling;
  while (next && parseInt(next.dataset.level) > level) {
    var cb = next.querySelector('.tree-child-cb');
    if (cb) cb.checked = parentCb.checked;
    next = next.nextElementSibling;
  }
}

function toggleTreeAll(allCb) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.tree-child-cb, .tree-parent-cb').forEach(function (cb) {
    cb.checked = allCb.checked;
  });
}
